questions.q: Under which Section of the Telecommunications Act, 2023, was the Universal Service Obligation Fund renamed as Digital Bharat Nidhi?
questions.solution:
Section 24(1) of the Telecommunications Act, 2023 provides for Digital Bharat Nidhi, the renamed Universal Service Obligation Fund.
**Answer: Section 24(1)**

questions.q: Select the law described by this statement: During a chemical reaction, mass is neither created nor destroyed.
questions.solution:
The law of conservation of mass states that total mass remains unchanged in an ordinary chemical reaction. Reactant mass equals product mass in a closed system.
**Answer: Law of conservation of mass**

questions.q: The relation between thrust (T), pressure (P) and area (A) of an object in a given medium is -
questions.solution:
Pressure equals thrust divided by area: P = T/A. Rearranging gives T = P × A.
**Answer: T= PxA**

questions.q: Which of the following is obtained upon heating ferrous sulphate?
options: Ferric oxide, sulphur dioxide and sulphur trioxide
questions.solution:
Heating ferrous sulphate produces ferric oxide, sulphur dioxide and sulphur trioxide. The decomposition is 2FeSO₄ → Fe₂O₃ + SO₂ + SO₃.
**Answer: Ferric oxide, sulphur dioxide and sulphur trioxide**

questions.q: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT about sodium carbonate?
options: Sodium carbonate is used in glass, soap and paper industries.
Sodium carbonate is used in the manufacture of sodium compounds, such as borax.
Sodium carbonate is used to neutralise excess acid in the stomach.
Sodium carbonate can be used as a cleaning agent for domestic purposes.
questions.solution:
Sodium bicarbonate, rather than sodium carbonate, is the familiar antacid for excess stomach acid. The listed industrial and cleaning uses of sodium carbonate are valid.
**Answer: Sodium carbonate is used to neutralise excess acid in the stomach.**

questions.q: In Fleming's left hand rule, which physical quantity is represented by the middle finger?
options: Direction of the motion of conductor
questions.solution:
In Fleming’s left-hand rule, the middle finger indicates current, the forefinger the magnetic field, and the thumb force or motion.
**Answer: Direction of electric current**

questions.q: Which cell organelle serves as a channel for transport of material between various regions of cytoplasm?
questions.solution:
The endoplasmic reticulum forms an internal membrane network. It provides channels for transport within the cell and participates in synthesis.
**Answer: Endoplasmic reticulum**

questions.q: What was the unemployment rate in India for individuals aged 15 years and above from July 2023 to June 2024?
questions.solution:
The PLFS annual usual-status unemployment rate for persons aged 15 and above was 3.2% for July 2023–June 2024. The estimate refers to that survey period.
**Answer: 3.2%**

questions.q: Which of the following Indian states hosted the 2023 Hornbill Music Festival?
questions.solution:
Nagaland hosted the Hornbill Music Festival in 2023. It is associated with the state’s wider Hornbill cultural festival.
**Answer: Nagaland**

questions.q: If a person can see far objects distinctly but cannot see nearby objects clearly, then this eye defect can be corrected by using
options: a concave lens of suitable power
a convex lens of suitable power
questions.solution:
Difficulty focusing on nearby objects while distant vision is clear is hypermetropia. A convex lens helps focus nearby light onto the retina.
**Answer: a convex lens of suitable power**

questions.q: Which of the following metals are mixed with iron to get stainless steel?
questions.solution:
Stainless steel commonly contains chromium and nickel mixed with iron. Chromium forms a protective surface layer that resists corrosion.
**Answer: nickel and chromium**

questions.q: Where does the centre of curvature of a concave mirror lie?
options: At the centre of the mirror
At the edge of the mirror
questions.solution:
The centre of curvature of a concave mirror is on its reflecting side, in front of the mirror. Its distance from the pole is the radius of curvature.
**Answer: In front of the mirror**

questions.q: In 2024, which bank partnered with Veefin Solutions to launch the SmartFin, a digital supply-chain finance platform?
questions.solution:
YES Bank partnered with Veefin Solutions to launch SmartFin in 2024. The platform supports digital supply-chain financing.
**Answer: YES Bank**

questions.q: What was the score for Goal 1 (No Poverty) in the 2023-24 SDG India Index?
questions.solution:
The SDG India Index 2023–24 gave Goal 1, No Poverty, a score of 72. Scores are reported on a scale of 0 to 100.
**Answer: 72**

questions.q: Blood brings carbon dioxide from the rest of the body for release into the:
questions.solution:
Carbon dioxide diffuses from blood into the alveoli in the lungs. It is then removed during exhalation.
**Answer: alveoli**

questions.q: Which physical quantity represents the rate at which electric energy is dissipated or consumed in an electric circuit?
questions.solution:
Electric power is the rate of consumption or transfer of electrical energy. It is measured in watts.
**Answer: Electric power**

questions.q: In June 2024, which of the following Indian cities was officially recognised as World Craft City by the World Crafts Council?
questions.solution:
The World Crafts Council recognised Srinagar as a World Craft City in June 2024, acknowledging its established craft traditions.
**Answer: Srinagar**

questions.q: Which of the following organisms reproduces by budding?
questions.solution:
Hydra reproduces asexually by budding. A small outgrowth develops into a new individual and can separate from the parent.
**Answer: Hydra**

questions.q: A moving body covers 10 m distance along a straight path in each second. The body is under which type of motion?
questions.solution:
Covering equal distances along the same straight path in equal time intervals is uniform rectilinear motion. The speed and direction remain constant.
**Answer: Uniform motion**

questions.q: A solution contains 40 ml of acid in 120 ml of water. Calculate the concentration in terms of volume by volume percentage of thesolution.
questions.solution:
Assuming volumes add, total solution volume = 40 + 120 = 160 mL. Acid concentration = 40/160 × 100 = 25% by volume.
**Answer: 25%**

questions.q: The joint exercise involving the Indian Army's Kharga Corps and the Indian Air Force in 2024 was conducted in which state?
questions.solution:
The joint Kharga Corps–Indian Air Force exercise referred to in the paper was conducted in Punjab in 2024.
**Answer: Punjab**

questions.q: Which award has been conferred to Narayan Chakraborty for his contribution in Science and Engineering in 2024?
questions.solution:
Narayan Chakraborty received the Padma Shri in 2024 for his contribution to science and engineering.
**Answer: Padma Shri**

questions.q: As of September 2024, who among the following cricketers (men) is India's second highest wicket taker in the Test Matches?
questions.solution:
Ravichandran Ashwin was India’s second-highest Test wicket-taker as of September 2024, behind Anil Kumble.
**Answer: R Ashwin**

questions.q: Reflex arcs are formed in which part of the nervous system?
questions.solution:
Many protective reflexes use circuits in the spinal cord. The short reflex pathway allows a rapid response without waiting for conscious processing.
**Answer: Spinal cord**

questions.q: As of September 2024, who among the following Indian Cricketers has a record of scoring 6 centuries and 522 wickets in test cricket to his credit?
questions.solution:
Ravichandran Ashwin was the cricketer with six Test centuries and the cited tally of 522 wickets in the September 2024 snapshot.
**Answer: Ravichandra Ashwin**

questions.q: A car moves with a uniform velocity (v) in a particular direction for a distance (s) under the action of a force (F) acting in the same direction. The work done by the force will be:
questions.solution:
Work by a constant force along the displacement is W = Fs. Velocity is not needed in this expression for work.
**Answer: Fs**

questions.q: Variegated leaves are found in which of the following plants?
questions.solution:
Croton commonly has variegated leaves with differently coloured areas. These can include green and non-green patches.
**Answer: Croton**

questions.q: Which elements of xylem tissue form interconnected water-conducting channels?
questions.solution:
Vessels and tracheids are the water-conducting elements of xylem. Their connected spaces provide pathways for water and minerals.
**Answer: Vessels and Tracheids**
